mission.title: No Fly
mission.description: Get the Machines' data on a blank spot on the map to the General, then clear his way past the Sentinels.

npc.say: Guard it carefully, operative. There is something here that the Machines do not want found.

Non, I do not know what we will find there. It is where the man Carlyne came from, if Halborn is to be believed. They have told us next to nothing about themselves; now, we find the answers for ourselves.

phase.briefing:
If you'll recall, Halborn let slip something about Carlyne being 800 miles northwest of the Machine city. Topographic data purloined from the Machines shows that the area is mountainous, which any fool with an atlas knows, but also that the regular grid of Machine pods and power lines breaks there, leaving a wide area apparently clear of Machine activity.
This data is obviously highly sensitive. For some reason, you've been chosen to handle a copy. I sense disaster.

enter.say: Looks like we've got some of the bigwigs in there. The Merv must think this is pretty important.

near.say: "Oligarchs"? Who're they supposed to be, then?
Something the skinny one thinks will keep the stocky one at bay. You really should keep up, you know.
Pshaw. Read Machine activity reports? Cruel and unusual punishment, that.

talk.say:
The Machine data is remarkably circumspect about the area, almost as if an information blackout is in effect. The Machines have seemed to be compelled to obey the wireframed men in certain ways; it is possible that the suppression of data on the area was ordered by Carlyne or Halborn.
Whatever the case may be, the Machines have tried to guard this information very carefully. It is not unlikely that they will attempt to recapture it.

done.say: Okay, apparently the Merv has instructions for you personally.

talk.say:
Intriguing, n'est-ce pas? A blank spot on the map--an area, peut-etre, which even the Machines avoid...
See that the General receives this data, {player}. He will be doing a little...reconnaissance.

phase.briefing:
When I heard you were to be involved, operative, I was skeptical.
Now that I know the General is in this as well, I can only say that failure can't come too soon. In fact, why don't we just chalk this up as a loss now and move on to the next opportunity?
Hmph. You really must play these things out, mustn't you? Fine... Just don't come crying to me when it all comes crashing down.

enter.say: So far, so good. No Machines in sight. The General should be broadcasting in there.

objective.text: Give the data to the Holographic Projection

done.say:
Hmh. That's a no-fly zone. Even Machine Sentinels won't be allowed there.
You can tell the Merovingian that we'll leave immediately. He should take the necessary measures.

phase.briefing:
Oh, of course the General couldn't be expected to handle things himself. That would be asking far too much...
Bah. Well, operative, what this means is that you'll be disrupting Machine Sentinel systems so that the General can get on his way without being caught. The location data we have for your target comes from the General himself, so...expect excellence.

enter.say: Damn, it looks like we're going to have heat from the Machines from here on in. Security in there is pretty stiff.

done.say:
I don't get it... It isn't accepting the input. Is this a Sentinel access terminal, or not? There isn't--
Uh-oh. What's he want now?

They've altered the control interface, doubtless because they suspected I had mastered its layout.
The new interface point must be located. My men and I can handle this. We'll have to capture one of their Sentinels...but we still have the element of surprise.

phase.briefing:
Any day now, Herr General...
Hm. Here we are: your new coordinates, operative, fresh from a Sentinel's skull. Let's hope they're a little less dated than the General's previous effort.

enter.say: Spiffy little network they've got running in there. This could be it. Watch the guards.

objective.text: Run the system disruption routine on the mainframe

done.say: Okay, hang on to your shorts: I'm running the system disruption routine now. This should give 'em something to think about.

mission.finish: The General's on his way to the blackout zone, operative...and good riddance to him. I console myself with the thought that he's almost certainly flying to his doom.
